info.description: Impor pemain dari format JSON atau CSV. Kolom wajib: steamId, name. Opsional: initialELO (bawaan 1500), avatarUrl.

placeholders.jsonCsv:
Format JSON:
[
  {
    "steamId": "76561198012345678",
    "name": "Pemain Satu",
    "initialELO": 1500,
    "avatarUrl": "https://..."
  }
]

Format CSV:
steamId,name,initialELO,avatarUrl
76561198012345678,Pemain Satu,1500,https://...
